newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY PRELIM. JAN-JULY C/A DEF. $963MLN.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY PRELIM. JAN-JULY C/A DEF. $963MLN.

text.p: Hungary's preliminary accumulated current account (C/A) deficit was $963 million in the January-July period, down from $2.047 billion in the same period of last year, the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said on Monday.
The C/A deficit was $29 million in July while the C/A balance did not change in July 1995, the NBH said in a statement.
Hungary's preliminary accumulated trade deficit amounted to $1.436 billion in the January-July period, down from a gap of $1.647 billion in the same seven months of 1995, it said.
The trade deficit in July was $242 million compared to $163 million in July 1995, the NBH said.
The preliminary figures showed that the country's international reserves stood at $9.284 billion at the end of July, down from $9.835 billion in June.
